platform: Apple M1 Pro, macOS ARM64 Release, 4 platform workers
changes: Recognize JSON leading whitespace before the top-level parallel-array probe; keep absolute source offsets.
Reuse the validated whitespace cursor on serial fallback instead of scanning the prefix twice.
Fill small numeric double-array storage before allocating its JSArray header, avoiding hole initialization.

protocol.order: AB BA BA AB within each cell
protocol.primary_targets: leading-whitespace 20 MB inputs; normal Canada numeric arrays
protocol.followup_rule: If a cell misses either regression gate, repeat its whole family once with reversed order, retaining and pooling all original results. Do not retest repeatedly until passing.
protocol.resources: whole-process CPU and peak RSS include loading, warmup, validation and explicit GC; not API-only measurements
protocol.scope: Mac ARM64 Release; correctness also DCHECK/heap verification. No performance run overlaps this task build/test work.
protocol.host_load: Record compiler processes at each process boundary; flag interference explicitly.
protocol.extra_controls: Six prefix fallback fixtures: 4097 or 4194304 spaces before a number, object or empty array. Reuse scanned whitespace on serial fallback.
protocol.calibration: Before the final comparisons, run four A/A pairs of the identical baseline on Canada and records12 20 MB. Preserve results and flag scheduling/layout variation; do not treat it as a candidate gain.
protocol.interference_disposition: The initial full series is retained as an interrupted diagnostic after observed Rust compiler contention. Acceptance uses the complete full-quiet series, with compiler waits before each process and compiler snapshots after each process.
protocol.micro_resolution: Original 4097-space single-call prefix controls can round to zero. Retain them as resolution-limited diagnostics; measure all three such cases with 128 sequential calls per timed batch and normalize by 128. The three 4 MiB controls retain their original nonzero timings.
protocol.concurrent_prefix_controls: Also compare four simultaneous leading-whitespace inputs for records12, records60, Canada and mixed_nested at 20 MB, because they newly enter the within-document parallel path.

performance.resolution_limited_note: All original single-call 4097-space controls are retained but excluded from ratio gates because some samples round to zero. Their replacements aggregate 128 calls per batch.

cross_compile.android_full_build_and_runtime: not completed: configured mksnapshot runner requires an adb device; none connected

static_checks.cctest_gn_header_dependencies: 12 pre-existing include dependency errors; all reported includes are present in the baseline
static_checks.cpplint_limit: 21 inherited issues remain; build/include_what_you_use is filtered

limitations: Whole-process CPU and peak RSS include input preparation, warmup, result validation and explicit GC.
The initial full series was interrupted and retained as a diagnostic after unrelated Rust compilation started; it is excluded from acceptance.
Compiler waits reduce observed contention but do not isolate the Mac from other system activity.
No full V8/test262 suite or Android runtime performance claim.
